atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Length", 10, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 50, 1)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 50, 1)
coilThresh = input(80.0, "Coil Threshold", 50.0, 95.0, 1.0)
predThresh = input(50.0, "Predictability Threshold", 10.0, 90.0, 1.0)
expansionMult = input(1.5, "Expansion Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr = max(high - low, max(abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1])))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
atrPeak = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
coilLoad = 100 * (1 - atrVal / max(atrPeak, 0.0001))
rangeNow = high - low
rangeMean = sma(rangeNow, coilLen)
rangeCoil = rangeNow / max(rangeMean, 0.0001)
atrPct = (atrVal - atrVal[1]) / max(atrVal[1], 0.0001) * 100
vov = stdev(atrPct, vovLen)
vovBase = sma(vov, vovLen)
vovRising = vov > vov[1] and vov > vovBase
absChg = abs(close - close[1])
sumAbs = sma(absChg, predLen) * predLen
predRead = abs(close - close[predLen]) / max(sumAbs, 0.0001) * 100
loaded = coilLoad >= coilThresh and rangeNow < rangeMean and vovRising
coilHigh = highest(high, coilLen)
coilLow = lowest(low, coilLen)
coilMid = (coilHigh + coilLow) / 2
release = loaded[1] and rangeNow > expansionMult * rangeMean and tr > expansionMult * atrVal[1]
buyRelease = release and close > coilMid
sellRelease = release and close < coilMid
loadedPred = loaded and predRead >= predThresh
loadedUnpred = loaded and predRead < predThresh
coilState = release ? 150.0 : (loadedPred ? 100.0 : (loadedUnpred ? 50.0 : 0.0))

bgcolor(loaded ? "#332b00" : "#00000000")
if buyRelease { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellRelease { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buyRelease { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, "separate") }
if sellRelease { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, "separate") }
plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predRead, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(predThresh, "#b48cff", "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "scatter", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predRead, "Predictability 3D", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(coilState, "Coil State 3D", "bars3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

sessLen = input(20, "SessionLength", 10, 200, 1)
htfTf = input("1h", "HTF Timeframe")
structLb = input(3, "StructureLookback", 1, 10, 1)
minDisp = input(0.10, "MinDisplacementPct", 0.01, 5.0, 0.01)
hardTicks = input(20, "HardStopTicks", 1, 200, 1)
minConf = input(60, "MinConfidence", 0, 100, 1)
tickSz = input(0.1, "Tick Size", 0.01, 10.0, 0.01)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfOpen = security("1h", open)

newHtf = htfClose != htfClose[1]

var hh1 = 0.0
var hh2 = 0.0
var hh3 = 0.0
var hh4 = 0.0
var hh5 = 0.0
var hh6 = 0.0
var hh7 = 0.0
var hh8 = 0.0
var hh9 = 0.0
var hh10 = 0.0
var ll1 = 0.0
var ll2 = 0.0
var ll3 = 0.0
var ll4 = 0.0
var ll5 = 0.0
var ll6 = 0.0
var ll7 = 0.0
var ll8 = 0.0
var ll9 = 0.0
var ll10 = 0.0

if newHtf {
    hh10 := hh9
    hh9 := hh8
    hh8 := hh7
    hh7 := hh6
    hh6 := hh5
    hh5 := hh4
    hh4 := hh3
    hh3 := hh2
    hh2 := hh1
    hh1 := htfHigh
    ll10 := ll9
    ll9 := ll8
    ll8 := ll7
    ll7 := ll6
    ll6 := ll5
    ll5 := ll4
    ll4 := ll3
    ll3 := ll2
    ll2 := ll1
    ll1 := htfLow
}

refHigh = structLb == 1 ? hh1 : structLb == 2 ? hh2 : structLb == 3 ? hh3 : structLb == 4 ? hh4 : structLb == 5 ? hh5 : structLb == 6 ? hh6 : structLb == 7 ? hh7 : structLb == 8 ? hh8 : structLb == 9 ? hh9 : hh10
refLow = structLb == 1 ? ll1 : structLb == 2 ? ll2 : structLb == 3 ? ll3 : structLb == 4 ? ll4 : structLb == 5 ? ll5 : structLb == 6 ? ll6 : structLb == 7 ? ll7 : structLb == 8 ? ll8 : structLb == 9 ? ll9 : ll10

htfValid = htfClose == htfClose and htfOpen == htfOpen and htfHigh == htfHigh and htfLow == htfLow and htfClose > 0 and refHigh > 0 and refLow > 0

bullStruct = htfValid and htfClose > refHigh
bearStruct = htfValid and htfClose < refLow

dispPct = abs(htfClose - htfOpen) / (abs(htfOpen) + 0.000000001) * 100
dispOk = dispPct > minDisp
htfRange = htfHigh - htfLow
posInRange = htfRange > 0 ? (htfClose - htfLow) / htfRange : 0.5
extremeOk = htfRange > 0 and (posInRange >= 0.75 or posInRange <= 0.25)
quality = 50 + (dispOk ? 25 : 0) + (extremeOk ? 25 : 0)
conf = htfValid ? quality : 0
conf01 = conf / 100

stopDist = hardTicks * tickSz

var longPx = 0.0
var shortPx = 0.0

longBreak = crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
shortBreak = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)

buySig = longBreak and bullStruct and conf >= minConf
sellSig = shortBreak and bearStruct and conf >= minConf

longStopHit = longPx > 0 and low <= longPx - stopDist
shortStopHit = shortPx > 0 and high >= shortPx + stopDist

exitLongSig = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) or longStopHit or bearStruct
exitShortSig = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) or shortStopHit or bullStruct

hasLong = longPx > 0
hasShort = shortPx > 0
exitLong = hasLong and exitLongSig
exitShort = hasShort and exitShortSig

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    longPx := close
    shortPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Long", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf01)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    shortPx := close
    longPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Short", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLong {
    model.exit("siege-exit-long")
    longPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "ExitL", "x", "#ffcc33")
}
if exitShort {
    model.exit("siege-exit-short")
    shortPx := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "ExitS", "x", "#ffcc33")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
volLen = input(20, "Volatility Length", 5, 50, 1)
brkLen = input(20, "Breakout Length", 5, 50, 1)
volMult = input(1.5, "Volatility Multiplier", 0.5, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

mom = close - close[momLen]
volBase = stdev(close, volLen)
volThresh = volBase * volMult
upperRaw = highest(high, brkLen)
lowerRaw = lowest(low, brkLen)
upper = upperRaw[1]
lower = lowerRaw[1]
brRange = high - low
rangeExp = brRange > volThresh

buySig = crossover(close, upper) and mom > 0 and rangeExp
sellSig = crossunder(close, lower) and mom < 0 and rangeExp
noBreak = not crossover(close, upper) and not crossunder(close, lower)
expandAlert = rangeExp and not rangeExp[1] and noBreak

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}
if expandAlert {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Expansion", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Expansion 3D", "diamond", "#ffcc33", markerSize, 2, "3d")
}
if rangeExp {
    bgcolor("#3a2a3a")
}

plot(upper, "Breakout Upper", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(lower, "Breakout Lower", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(upper, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lower, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
r236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6% Ratio", 0.05, 0.9, 0.001)
r382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2% Ratio", 0.05, 0.9, 0.001)
r50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50% Ratio", 0.05, 0.9, 0.001)
r618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8% Ratio", 0.05, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

hh = highest(high, lookback)
ll = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = hh - ll

l236 = hh - rng * r236
l382 = hh - rng * r382
l50 = hh - rng * r50
l618 = hh - rng * r618

var lastBuyBar = 0.0
var lastBuyPx = 0.0
var lastSellBar = 0.0
var lastSellPx = 0.0

buySig = crossover(close, l618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, l382)

if buySig {
    lastBuyBar := bar_index
    lastBuyPx := l618
}
if sellSig {
    lastSellBar := bar_index
    lastSellPx := l382
}

isBuyLast = lastBuyBar > lastSellBar and lastBuyBar > 0
isSellLast = lastSellBar > lastBuyBar and lastSellBar > 0

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

if barstate.islast and isBuyLast {
    text.new(lastBuyBar, lastBuyPx, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibEvent")
    label3d(lastBuyBar, lastBuyPx, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 0.9, 3, "3d")
}
if barstate.islast and isSellLast {
    text.new(lastSellBar, lastSellPx, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibEvent")
    label3d(lastSellBar, lastSellPx, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 0.9, 1, "3d")
}

plot(l236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(l382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(l50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(l618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(l236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(l382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(l50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(l618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Len", 5, 30, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Len", 15, 60, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Len", 30, 120, 1)
skewLen = input(30, "Skew Len", 10, 90, 1)
compressLen = input(60, "Compression Len", 20, 120, 1)
compressPct = input(25, "Compress Pct", 5, 50, 1)
expandMult = input(1.15, "Expand Mult", 1.02, 1.5, 0.01)
skewBull = input(0.2, "Skew Bull", 0.0, 0.9, 0.05)
skewBear = input(-0.2, "Skew Bear", -0.9, 0.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = close[1] == 0 ? 0 : log(close / close[1])
sqrt252 = sqrt(252)
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt252
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt252
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt252
hh = highest(high, skewLen)
ll = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hh - ll
skew = rng == 0 ? 0 : ((close - ll) / (rng + 0.000000001) - 0.5) * 2
spread = fastVol - slowVol
slopeMid = medVol - slowVol
fastMax = highest(fastVol, compressLen)
fastMin = lowest(fastVol, compressLen)
fastRange = fastMax - fastMin
rangeMax = highest(fastRange, compressLen)
rangeMin = lowest(fastRange, compressLen)
compressThresh = rangeMin + (rangeMax - rangeMin) * compressPct / 100
compressed = fastRange <= compressThresh
fastMaxPrev = fastMax[1]
wasCompressed = compressed[1] or compressed[2] or compressed[3]
expansion = fastVol > fastMaxPrev * expandMult and fastVol > medVol and wasCompressed
expansionEdge = expansion and not expansion[1]
skewPrev = skew[1]
skewFlipBull = skew > skewBull and skewPrev <= 0
skewFlipBear = skew < skewBear and skewPrev >= 0

var lastSig = 0
coolOk = bar_index - lastSig > 5
buySig = expansionEdge and skewFlipBull and coolOk
sellSig = expansionEdge and skewFlipBear and coolOk
if buySig or sellSig {
    lastSig := bar_index
}

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    model.longEntry("Buy")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    model.shortEntry("Sell")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

bullDen = medVol + 0.000000001
bullRatio = medVol == 0 ? 1 : fastVol / bullDen
bullThrDyn = bar_index < slowLen ? skewBull : skewBull * bullRatio
bearThrDyn = bar_index < slowLen ? skewBear : skewBear * bullRatio

plot(spread, "Spread F-S", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#ffaa00", 2, "separate")
plot(bullThrDyn, "Bull Thr", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(bearThrDyn, "Bear Thr", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(medVol, "Term Sheet", "manifold", "#4488ff", "separate")
plot3d(fastVol, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(spread, "Spread Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffaa00", "separate")

ch1 = input(20, "CH1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "CH2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "CH3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "CH4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "CH5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
baseWidth = input(2, "Base Width", 0.5, 5, 0.1)
widthFactor = input(0.08, "Width Factor", 0, 0.2, 0.01)
buyThreshold = input(70, "Buy Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
sellThreshold = input(30, "Sell Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

wob = (close - open) * 0.5

c1raw = ch1 + wob
c1c = max(c1raw, 0)
c1 = min(c1c, 100)
c2raw = ch2 + wob
c2c = max(c2raw, 0)
c2 = min(c2c, 100)
c3raw = ch3 + wob
c3c = max(c3raw, 0)
c3 = min(c3c, 100)
c4raw = ch4 + wob
c4c = max(c4raw, 0)
c4 = min(c4c, 100)
c5raw = ch5 + wob
c5c = max(c5raw, 0)
c5 = min(c5c, 100)

h1 = c1 * 1.0
h2 = c2 * 1.0
h3 = c3 * 1.0
h4 = c4 * 1.0
h5 = c5 * 1.0

avg = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5
wCurve = baseWidth + widthFactor * avg

max12 = max(c1, c2)
max123 = max(max12, c3)
max1234 = max(max123, c4)
maxC = max(max1234, c5)
min12 = min(c1, c2)
min123 = min(min12, c3)
min1234 = min(min123, c4)
minC = min(min1234, c5)
spread = maxC - minC

h5Highest = c5 >= c1 and c5 >= c2 and c5 >= c3 and c5 >= c4
h1Highest = c1 >= c2 and c1 >= c3 and c1 >= c4 and c1 >= c5

buySig = crossover(avg, buyThreshold) and h5Highest
sellSig = crossunder(avg, sellThreshold) and h1Highest
alertCond = spread > 60 and avg > sellThreshold and avg < buyThreshold
alertSig = alertCond and not alertCond[1]

buyConeSize = markerSize * (0.7 + avg * 0.006)
sellConeSize = markerSize * (0.7 + avg * 0.006)

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if alertSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Spread", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

plot(c1, "CH1", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
plot(c2, "CH2", "#33ddaa", 1, "separate")
plot(c3, "CH3", "#ffcc00", 1, "separate")
plot(c4, "CH4", "#ff8833", 1, "separate")
plot(c5, "CH5", "#cc55ff", 1, "separate")
plot(avg, "Spline Avg", "#ffffff", 2, "separate")
plot(wCurve, "Curve Width", "#88ccff", 1, "separate")

plot3d(h1, "CH1 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#33aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(h2, "CH2 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#33ddaa", "separate", 1)
plot3d(h3, "CH3 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#ffcc00", "separate", 2)
plot3d(h4, "CH4 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 3)
plot3d(h5, "CH5 Cylinder", "bars3d", "#cc55ff", "separate", 4)
plot3d(avg, "Spline Curve", "ribbon", "#33aaff", "separate", 5)

if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, c5, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", buyConeSize, 4, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, c1, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", sellConeSize, 0, "separate")
}
